title: Greek Kofta with Crunchy Salad
description: A hearty Greek-inspired dish featuring kofta and crunchy toppings. Perfect for a dinner or lunch option.

ingredients.name: Greek Kofta Meat Mix
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or make your own mix of lamb, beef and spices.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: A type of cheese that has a crunchy texture and a tangy flavor.

ingredients.name: Greek Vinaigrette
ingredients.notes: A mix of olive oil, lemon juice and herbs.

ingredients.name: Greek Olives
ingredients.notes: Sliced olives for added flavor and texture.

ingredients.name: Crunchy Bread
ingredients.notes: For serving with the kofta and salad.

instructions: Skewer the kofta meat mix and cook for 5-6 minutes per side.
Let the kofta rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Prepare the crunchy salad by combining the feta cheese, olives, red onion and parsley.
Drizzle the Greek vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve the sliced kofta with the crunchy salad and crunchy bread on the side.
